Whole class (batch)

Every name gets its own certificate with the same settings below. Paste a name and a reason as two columns straight from a spreadsheet (tab-separated), or type a comma after the name, to give just that student their own specific reason instead of the shared one — e.g. "Alex Rivera, for helping a classmate with the fraction unit." Add "| Custom Title" at the end to also swap that student's award title.

Upload a scanned or photographed signature to print above the signature line instead of just the typed text.

Adds a small QR code to the certificate that scans to a congratulatory note, video, or portfolio page.

1 per page
2 per page

Two per page works well for smaller awards — a homework pass or a "caught being kind" slip doesn't need a whole sheet of paper. Cut along the dashed guide.

Store-bought certificate paper has the border already printed on it. Set how much of the edge that border eats and everything on the certificate — text, logo, QR code, alignment guides — pulls in to the clear area inside it, instead of printing over the design you paid for. Measure the printed border on one sheet with a ruler and round up. Leave this on “None” for plain paper.

Draws the boundary your content is being kept inside — the page edge, or the safe area if you set a stock border above. Print a test copy on plain paper, hold it up to the light against your stock, and adjust your printer's margins if it doesn't line up. Turn this off before printing the final copies.
